name: All These Pieces
thesis: A deep-plum magazine cover interleaves enormous cream name lettering with the purple Monstrosity, Raygen’s cat avatar, a software fragment, and official Outpost art. The assembled portrait opens into stories of machines, code, teaching, and community.
interaction: Select any cover artifact or the four native facet buttons to change a composed reading area and its chapter link. Mouse and pen users can give artifacts a bounded 24-pixel tug before they snap back; touch and keyboard users can select the same pieces. The surname subtly spreads when the software fragment is selected.
why: Combines 06’s image-and-type layering, 05’s purple personal atmosphere, and 11’s moving typography with One Stone safety teaching, Centennial shop leadership, Stardance software contributions, Outpost peer support, and a closing personal letter.
